explanation: From main: swHandover.test.ts adds a regression test that registerUpdates() registers nothing and adds no listeners when VITE_SERVICE_WORKER is unset, because registering the self-destroying sw.js would reload every visit; the existing handover tests still cover the opt-in worker. From the mobile pass: pathwayToolbar.test.tsx finds the pager arrows by their new accessible names, Previous page and Next page, instead of the bare chevron glyphs.
